name: assetRiskScorePercentage
definition: The mean per-asset risk score, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100 (higher is riskier), across the in-scope assets, as the scanner computes it.
population: every non-deprecated asset the scanner lists for one company (the passport's); a read whose rows span more than one company_id, or a row with none, is not measured; denominator = that count of assets
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every active asset of one company, each carrying a numeric risk score on a confirmed scale.
citations: ConnectSecure public Swagger, GET /r/asset/asset_view: <pod>/apidocs/swagger.yaml (each vendor pod publishes it), see https://cybercns.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CVB/pages/2128314664/V4+API+Information (read 2026-10-12)

changeLog.change: Registered so the ConnectSecure transforms can emit it. The meaning is the catalogue description made precise; unverified fields are named in the transform docstring.

notes: Registered for the ConnectSecure transforms. Other vendors' transforms already emit this key (Intruder, Rapid7, Action1, Amazon Inspector); whether they measure the same population was not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0 and the owner is not yet named. The ConnectSecure transform does not score this key yet: the vendor's public API description types avg_risk_score as an integer and gives no scale (0 to 10 or 0 to 100), so it returns null with dataCollection error until a real tenant read confirms the scale.
